content:
pagerduty-bot: [PAGER] P1 - Elevated 5xx error rate on inference-api for EU traffic. Observed spike since 11:02 UTC. Suggested runbook: cross-region-routing/fallback.

sophia: I'm on it — opening console. Seeing p50 jump >200ms and 5xx burst for customers hitting eu endpoints. Seems cross-region egress to eu-west toggling.

robert: ack. Looking at routing-controller logs. Latency steering for policy rp-4a9c is oscillating between eu-west and eu-central. Pin state appears to be drifting during policy eval.

sanjay: can you paste the policy id/last rollout? I'll check control plane changes.

robert: policy id rp-4a9c. Last rollout at 1734566000 by infra-deploy. Snippet from config:
```
match: latency < 120 -> prefer eu-west
else -> prefer eu-central
pin: auto
```
Behavior: controller sometimes sets pin_state: pending and never commits, then another controller overrides with different region.

sophia: customers impacted: batch/stream endpoints for Product X, mostly EU and a few APAC proxied through EU. Need mitigation now — ETA?

robert: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable latency-based steering for rp-4a9c, 2) force a pin to eu-west for 10 minutes, 3) monitor.

sophia: do the override and confirm.

infra-oncall: running pin override: `redwoodctl routing override set --policy rp-4a9c --region eu-west --duration 600`
infra-oncall: CLI response: 200 OK, override id ov-9c3f applied.

routing-bot: Override applied by infra-oncall. Active region: eu-west. Edge TTL updates propagating (~11s).

sophia: watching metrics... 5xxs dropping from ~18% -> ~2% within 90s. p50 latency back to ~70ms. Looks effective.

emma: drafting status page and customer comms. Suggested note: 'Mitigation applied; partial degradation resolved; investigation ongoing.' I'll post when you confirm stability.

sophia: confirm. Moving to mitigation state. Please hold public notice until we have stable numbers.

robert: quick debug note: controllers A and B both reconciled same policy simultaneously; writes show `pin_state: pending` then a race to commit. Suspect missing distributed locking in controller sync. Adding a mutex in sync loop is immediate patch.

sanjay: can we ship a minimal hotfix to add an etcd-backed lock? Roll to 10% then ramp if healthy.

robert: I can implement a TTL lock using existing etcd lease keys. Plan: acquire lease, attempt write, release on success. No schema change. Low risk.

pagerduty-bot: Escalating to ENG-SRE at 11:18 UTC per runbook.

infra-oncall: starting hotfix rollout: `kubectl set env deployment/routing-controller CONTROLLER_LOCK=etcd-lease --namespace infra` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/routing-controller -l group=controller-a --namespace=infra`.

routing-bot: Controller group A rolled. Health checks passing. Pin stability metrics show no flapping for 5m.

sophia: good. Keep monitoring for 30m. If stable, we'll extend override to allow safe roll-forward of controller patch.

emma: status page updated: 'Mitigation applied; error rates reduced; engineering investigating root cause.' Sent to impacted customers with contact instructions.

robert: post-incident follow-ups: will own postmortem. Initial root cause: race condition on pin writes across controller replicas leading to inconsistent region pin state and oscillating steering decisions. Remediation: etcd lease locking, add e2e test for concurrent writes, improve canary for routing-policy rollouts.

sophia: assign postmortem owner to robert. He will include timeline, customer impact numbers, and remediation timeline.

infra-oncall: runbook updated with override command and expected TTL behavior: https://internal.gist/rp-4a9c-override

sophia: oncall handoff: I'll hand over to robert at 12:00 UTC to own the follow-up and closure.

robert: ack, I'll take ownership and start drafting the postmortem.

sophia: thanks everyone — closing incident mitigation thread but keeping follow-up items open. :white_check_mark:
